about_the_game:
This is an super interesting add-on to the main game - "Kill Dee". You can play as Dirty larry in it. To find out what he was doing. Events run parallel to the events of the main game.
Graphic style is very simple and cartoon stylized, but are some improvements and changes: concept style from "stickman" to "cartoon man".
Playtime  - 3 extra levels and some story later.

First level - capturing of Spring City.
Second level - capturing of WindStad.
Third level - find out. Experience joy, sadness and inspiration in a world you will never forget.


P.S If you have any question or troubles with the game - write to me on Steam -
